ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics dashboard forecasting campus safety incidents and maintenance bottlenecks across NC State's brick paths and residence halls using historical campus police logs and weather data.
ideas.title: PackAlert: NC State Campus Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles local relevance for NC State students and campus stakeholders, mirroring the rigorous forecasting approach of proven winners like ai-incident-forecasting.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support platform tailored for NC State that answers complex queries about campus sustainability initiatives, building energy usage, and recycling protocols using localized vector databases.
ideas.title: WolfTrack Campus Sustainability RAG Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes a sophisticated multi-agent RAG workflow proven effective at student-centric hackathons, ensuring high engagement from university-affiliated judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform customized for NC State students that delivers personalized meal recommendations based on dining hall menus and local Hillsborough Street restaurants.
ideas.title: Raleigh Eats Nutrition & Local Dining Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday student pain point with immediate, tangible utility during a 31-hour sprint, similar to how E-Foodiee won the Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring tool tracking urban sprawl, construction progress, and land compliance in the greater Raleigh-Durham triangle area using open-source geospatial data.
ideas.title: Triangle Land CompliSat: Satellite Monitoring
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings hard engineering and complex geospatial data processing to the table, impressing judges looking for technical depth over simple wrapper apps.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace enabling NC State student clubs to manage event ticketing and merchandise sales with instant escrow payments.
ideas.title: WolfPay Autonomous Student Club Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical campus utility with autonomous transaction workflows, following the winning pattern of the Synthesis Hackathon.
